title: The factory's work-type table pins model ids a container boot would refuse (cloudflare-workers-ai/... vs workers-ai/...)
body: wrangler.toml's RUN_WORKER_MODEL examples and image/common.sh's provider list use the workers-ai/... prefix that is legal as a container's TICKS_MODEL; the committed RUN_WORKER_MODEL_BY_WORK_TYPE table pins cloudflare-workers-ai/@cf/zai-org/glm-5.3(-flash), the pi-profile spelling this repository's own routing uses everywhere else. When s45 (or any tick) wires the table's value into a cloud dispatch, a value routed into a container boot will be refused with 'cannot tell which provider serves the model'. The wiring tick must translate between spellings or settle one spelling per consumer; nothing in this tick's Go tests can catch it because no test boots a container.
